transcript.content: Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

Hi Sky, thanks for taking my call. I'm actually booking a flight from London to Rome in a few weeks' time and I wanted to check on the baggage policy before I book to make sure I understand everything correctly. Can you tell me what's included in my economy ticket and how much extra it would cost if I need to bring more than one bag?

For an economy ticket, you can bring one piece of hand luggage up to 10 kg (56 x 45 x 25 cm) and one personal item up to 5 kg (40 x 30 x 15 cm) into the cabin. There is no hold baggage included with an economy ticket, so any checked bags would need to be purchased separately.

An extra checked bag would cost £35.

That helps clarify things, thanks Sky. So just to confirm, if I want to bring a second checked bag with me on the flight, that would cost an additional £35, is that right? And are there any weight limits for the hand luggage and personal item that I need to be aware of?

Yes, that's correct. An additional checked bag would cost £35.

For hand luggage, the maximum weight is 10 kg, and for a personal item, it's 5 kg.

I'm good with those weights. Just one more thing, Sky - are there any specific restrictions on things like liquids or electronics in my hand luggage or personal item, or is that just a general guideline I should follow?

I can only provide information on Sky Airways' baggage allowance policies. For specific restrictions on liquids or electronics in hand luggage, I recommend checking the security guidelines on our website or at the airport.

That's okay, thanks for letting me know where to look for more information. I'll definitely check the website and maybe talk to one of your staff again if I have any questions about that before my flight. Can I ask, are there any other options or upgrades available on economy flights like this, such as an upgrade to a higher class of service or priority boarding?

I can only provide information on our baggage policies and help with booking or managing flights. I don't have information about specific upgrade options or priority boarding availability for economy flights. You might find more details on our website or by speaking with a representative at the airport.

Okay, that makes sense. Well, thanks for trying to help me out, Sky. I think I've got a good idea of the baggage situation now, and I'll definitely check the website again before my flight. Is it possible to add an extra checked bag to my booking later if I need to?
Yes, you can add an extra checked bag to your booking later. To do that, I'll need your booking reference. Do you have it handy?

I should have asked for the booking reference earlier. My flight number is GY1234 and my departure city is London Heathrow. Can you check if everything is okay with those details before I proceed to add an extra checked bag?
I can't use a flight number and departure city to access your booking details. To add an extra checked bag, I'll need your booking reference, which typically looks like BK-XXXXXX. Do you have that?

I don't actually have the booking reference with me right now. It's on a letter I received from Sky Airways when I booked my flight. Would it be possible to look up my booking details and send me the booking reference by email, or would that require me to provide some other information?

I'm sorry, but for security and privacy reasons, I cannot send you your booking reference via email or look it up without the reference number itself. You would need to provide me with the booking reference, which is usually in the format BK-XXXXXX, for me to access your booking details.

If you have the letter from Sky Airways, the booking reference should be clearly stated on it.

I understand about security and privacy reasons. In that case, I'll just go dig out my letter to confirm everything. Can I come back later if I need to add an extra checked bag or check on anything else with my booking?
Yes, of course. Please feel free to contact us again when you have your booking reference or if you need any further assistance. I'll be here to help.
Thanks, Sky. I think that's all for now then. Goodbye.

transcript.content: Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

"Hi Sky, thanks for answering. My name is Emily Wilson, and I'm actually flying economy to Rome next week. I just wanted to get a better understanding of the baggage policy before my trip, could you please tell me what I can bring in the cabin with me?"

Certainly, Emily. For economy class, you can bring one piece of hand luggage with maximum dimensions of 56 x 45 x 25 cm and a maximum weight of 10 kg. In addition to that, you can also bring one personal item, such as a handbag, laptop bag, or small backpack, with maximum dimensions of 40 x 30 x 15 cm and a maximum weight of 5 kg.

Is there anything else I can help you with regarding your flight to Rome?
"That sounds okay, but just to clarify, is the hand luggage included in the economy ticket price, or is it an extra fee? And are hold bags included in the ticket price at all?"

Yes, the hand luggage and personal item I mentioned are included in your economy ticket price.

Regarding hold bags, for economy class, there is no hold baggage included in the ticket price. You would need to purchase hold baggage separately if you wish to bring any.

Does that clarify everything for you?

"Okay, that's good to know. So, just to confirm, I can bring one hand luggage and one personal item with me on board, but there's an extra charge for a hold bag if I want to check any luggage at all. What's the weight limit for a hold bag, please?"

That's correct, you can bring one hand luggage and one personal item on board with your economy ticket. Any hold bags would be an additional charge.

If you purchase a hold bag, the standard weight limit is 23 kg. If a bag weighs between 23 kg and 32 kg, an overweight fee of £25 will apply. Bags weighing over 32 kg are not accepted.

Is there anything else I can help you with today, Emily?

"That sounds fair. So if I want to bring a hold bag that's under 23 kg, is it included in the ticket price or is there an extra fee for checking the bag? And how much would it cost to add an extra checked bag on top of my initial hold baggage?"

To clarify, for economy class, no hold baggage is included in your ticket price. Therefore, if you wish to bring a hold bag, even if it's under 23 kg, there will be an extra fee for checking that bag.

The cost to add a checked bag is £35. This fee applies to each checked bag you add.

Does that make sense?

"I understand now. So just to confirm, if I want to check a hold bag that's under 23 kg, I'll need to pay an extra £35 on top of my ticket price. Is there anything else I should know about baggage fees or any other costs associated with checking a hold bag?"

That's correct, Emily. If you want to check a hold bag under 23 kg, it will cost £35.

In addition to that, here are some other potential costs:

   Overweight bags: If your bag weighs between 23 kg and 32 kg, there's an additional fee of £25. Bags over 32 kg are not accepted.
   Oversized bags: If your bag exceeds standard dimensions, an oversized bag fee of £40 will apply.
   Special items: For items like sports equipment (bicycles, golf clubs, skis, surfboards), there's a fee of £60. Prams and pushchairs are carried free of charge.

These fees apply per piece per flight.

Is there anything else I can clarify for you about baggage or your upcoming flight?

"That sounds clear, thank you. Just to confirm, if I check a hold bag that's under 23 kg on my Rome flight, I'll pay £35, and if it's overweight between 23kg-32kg, I'll need to add another £25 fee. Is that correct?"

Yes, that is absolutely correct, Emily.

If your hold bag is under 23 kg, the cost will be £35. If it weighs between 23 kg and 32 kg, you will pay the initial £35 for the bag, plus an additional £25 overweight fee, making the total £60 for that bag.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?

"No, that's all for now. Thank you for explaining everything to me, Sky. Can I just confirm that if I book my flight and pay for hold baggage, I'll receive a confirmation of the booking and any applicable fees?"

Yes, that's right. Once you book your flight and add any hold baggage, you will receive a booking confirmation email to the address you provide. This email will include all the details of your flight, the breakdown of any applicable fees for your hold baggage, and a secure link for payment.

Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Emily?
"No, that's perfect, thank you so much. I think I've got everything covered now. Thank you again for all your help, Sky."

transcript.content: Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

Hi Sky, thanks for taking my call. I'm actually calling because I'm about to book a flight from London to Rome in a few days and I want to make sure I understand the baggage policy before I go ahead with the booking. Could you tell me what's included in the economy fare and how much extra it would cost if I need to bring any carry-on bags or check-in luggage?

Certainly! I can help you with that.

For economy class, you are allowed one piece of hand luggage with maximum dimensions of 56 x 45 x 25 cm and a maximum weight of 10 kg. You can also bring one personal item, such as a handbag, laptop bag, or small backpack, with maximum dimensions of 40 x 30 x 15 cm and a maximum weight of 5 kg. These are included in your fare.

However, hold baggage is not included in the economy fare and must be purchased separately. If you need to check in a bag, the fee for an extra bag is £35. For bags weighing between 23 kg and 32 kg, there is an additional fee of £25. Bags over 32 kg are not accepted.

Does this clarify our baggage policy for you?

That helps a lot, thank you Sky! Just to confirm, I'll be bringing a medium-sized suitcase that weighs around 30 kg, is that okay with the £35 fee for checking it in or would I need to pay an extra £25 because of its weight?

Yes, that's a great question for clarification. Since your suitcase weighs around 30 kg, it falls into the overweight category for hold baggage (between 23 kg and 32 kg).

Therefore, you would pay the £35 fee for checking in the bag, plus an additional £25 overweight fee. So, the total cost for that one 30 kg suitcase would be £60.
So just to confirm, if I book my flight now and add the extra hold baggage with a weight of 30 kg, the total cost for the luggage will be £60, which is included in my economy fare. Is that correct?

That's almost correct. The total cost for the 30 kg hold baggage would indeed be £60 (£35 for the extra bag and £25 for the overweight fee).

However, this £60 is an additional cost and is not included in your economy fare. You would pay this separately when you add the baggage to your booking.

Does that make sense?

I think I understand now, so the extra £60 for the hold baggage isn't part of my initial fare price, but rather an additional cost I'd need to pay when I book. Is there a way to calculate the total cost of the flight upfront, including any potential baggage fees, or would that information be available once I've completed the booking process?

You're right to want to understand the full cost upfront.

Here's how it works: I can help you find the price of the flight itself using the `search_flights` tool. We've already established the baggage fees for your 30 kg suitcase would be £60.

When you proceed to book a flight, the initial price you see will be for the flight only. During the booking process, or after you've made the booking, you would then add the hold baggage as an extra. The system will then show you the combined total before you finalize everything.

So, while I can give you the flight price and the baggage fee separately, the final combined total would be presented to you during the booking flow or in your booking confirmation email.

Would you like me to go ahead and search for flights for you from London to Rome for your desired dates?

That makes sense. I think I'd like you to check if there are any available flights from London to Rome on my preferred dates, please. Can you just give me a rough idea of what times and prices might be looking like?
Certainly! To give you an idea of available flights, could you please tell me your preferred date of travel from London to Rome?

I'm flying out on the 15th of April. I've got a bit of a gap in my schedule before then, so I think that would work well for me. Is there a specific time of day or preferred flight number you can give me an idea of what's available?

I apologize, but it seems there are no direct flights available from London to Rome on April 15, 2026, in economy class.

Would you like me to check for flights on a different date, or perhaps to a different destination?

That's disappointing. Could you also please check if there are any indirect flights available from London to Rome on April 15, 2026, in economy class? I'd be willing to consider an option with a layover if necessary.

I understand your disappointment. Unfortunately, my tools are designed to search for direct flights only and do not have the capability to search for indirect flights or flights with layovers.

Since there are no direct flights available on April 15th, would you like me to check for direct flights on a different date, or perhaps for flights to a different city in Italy? Alternatively, you might find more options for indirect flights by checking our website directly.

I think I'll try searching for it myself on your website. Could you please give me the details of how to find and book flights online? And just to confirm, I've got my 30 kg hold baggage fee sorted out, but if there are any changes to the fare or fees when I search for flights, would that be reflected in the booking price as well?

I understand you'd like to search on our website. To find and book flights online, please visit the official Sky Airways website. You'll typically find a "Book Flight" or "Search Flights" section on the homepage where you can enter your departure and arrival cities, dates, and number of passengers.

Regarding the baggage fees, the £60 for your 30 kg hold baggage is an additional cost. When you search for flights on the website, the initial fare displayed will be for the flight itself, without the baggage. You will have the option to add checked baggage during the booking process, and at that point, the total cost, including the baggage fee, will be updated and clearly shown before you finalize your purchase.

Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

No, that's all for now. I think I've got a good understanding of the baggage policy and how to search for flights online. Thank you so much for your help and patience, Sky! Perfect, thank you so much!
